title: Why Outperforming SPY Isn't Enough When Running The Wheel
text: The other thing to keep in mind is with the wheel, you are creating occurrences, meaning you are actively trading. Each time you interact with the market, there's a cost associated with that via friction of different sorts. And there's tax implications. So, you cannot look at it as, "Oh, I just need to, you know, outperform the spy by a percent over a 10-year window." Because once you include costs and all that stuff, you're drastically underperforming. You have to do a little bit better than that.
